edges.reason: The birch pressure plate is on the floor next to the potted lily of the valley inside the flower shop; finding the pot reveals the pressure plate location
The blue stained glass pane is in the window of the same blacksmith workshop where the smithing table is located; entering the workshop to find the table reveals the glass pane
The black and blue stained glass panes are in the same window (black on top, blue on bottom); spotting the black pane identifies the window containing the blue pane
The gilded blackstone is directly beneath the lime wool display; finding the wool reveals the blackstone that must be mined
The diorite stairs mark the starting point of the road; the player must locate them to know where to begin building
The gilded blackstone is embedded in the road corridor at ground level, physically blocking the road path; it must be mined to clear space for road construction

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The potted lily of the valley is at spawn-relative (7, 1, 5) inside the east flower shop. Player must navigate into the building (doorway at z=2) and face the back shelf. Distance from spawn is ~8.6 blocks, well exceeding max_distance=4, so actual navigation is required.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The smithing table is at spawn-relative (-7, 1, 3) inside the west blacksmith workshop. Distance from spawn is ~7.6 blocks, exceeding max_distance=4, requiring the player to enter the building through the doorway at (-7, z=2).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The lime wool is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 5) on the central corridor display stand. Distance from spawn is ~5.1 blocks, exceeding max_distance=4, so the player must walk north to observe it. Must be completed before mining gilded_blackstone (which removes its support block).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The black stained glass pane is at spawn-relative (-5, 2, 4) on the exterior east wall of the west blacksmith building. Distance from spawn is ~6.7 blocks, exceeding max_distance=5, requiring navigation toward the building. Target at y=2 requires looking slightly upward.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The diorite stairs are at spawn-relative (0, 0, -5) marking the road start to the south. Distance from spawn is 5 blocks, exceeding max_distance=4. Player must walk south and face the stairs (requiring a 180-degree turn from default north-facing spawn).

Uses inventory_has because birch pressure plates drop themselves when mined by hand (no tool required). The pressure plate is on the flower shop floor at (7, 0, 4). Player starts with 0 birch pressure plates, so obtaining 1 confirms successful mining.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because blue stained glass panes drop NOTHING when broken without Silk Touch (player has no Silk Touch). Cannot use inventory_has. Instead verifies the block no longer exists at its location (-5, 1, 4) within a box encompassing the west building window area.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because gilded blackstone has a 10% chance to drop 2-5 gold nuggets INSTEAD of itself when mined with a pickaxe. Using inventory_has would have a 10% failure rate. Instead verifies the block is absent from a box around its location (0, 0, 5) in the road corridor. Iron pickaxe is provided to the player.

Uses count_in_box_at_least because building a road means placing path-like blocks on the ground. Checks for at least 5 cobblestone blocks in the central road corridor (x=-2 to 2, y=0, z=-4 to 7). Only cobblestone is provided in inventory (64 blocks), ensuring consistency. No cobblestone exists in this area initially (ground is grass_block at y=-1, air at y=0). 5 blocks represents a meaningful road segment.

scene_description: A compact village scene with three areas arranged around a central north-south road corridor. East (x=5-9, z=2-6): A flower shop with oak plank construction containing a potted lily of the valley on the back shelf and a birch pressure plate on the floor. West (x=-9 to -5, z=2-6): A blacksmith workshop with stone brick construction containing a smithing table, with a window featuring black (top) and blue (bottom) stained glass panes. Center corridor (x=0, z=5): A wool display with lime wool atop gilded blackstone, physically blocking the road path. South (z=-5): Diorite stairs marking the road's starting point. The road corridor runs from z=-5 northward through the center of the scene.
task_text: Explore this village area to find several items and landmarks: a potted lily of the valley in the flower shop, a smithing table in the blacksmith workshop, lime wool on a display stand in the central path, a black stained glass pane in a window, and diorite stairs to the south. Then mine the birch pressure plate near the flower pot, break the blue stained glass pane in the workshop window, and mine the gilded blackstone blocking the central path using the provided iron pickaxe. Finally, build a road by placing at least 5 cobblestone blocks in the central corridor from the diorite stairs northward.
design_notes: Final validated scene. Player spawns at (0,0,0) facing north. Ground: grass_block at y=-1, air above. East building (flower shop): oak plank floor y=0, walls y=1-3, interior air y=1-2, potted lily at (7,1,5) supported by floor, birch pressure plate at (7,0,4) supported by grass at y=-1, doorway at (7,y=1-2,z=2). West building (blacksmith): stone brick floor y=0, walls y=1-3, interior air y=1-2, smithing table at (-7,1,3), black glass pane at (-5,2,4), blue glass pane at (-5,1,4), doorway at (-7,y=1-2,z=2). Center corridor: gilded blackstone at (0,0,5) blocking road, lime wool at (0,1,5), oak fences at (±1,1,5). South: diorite stairs at (-1/0/1,0,-5). Road corridor: x=-2 to 2, y=0, z=-4 to 7. Player given 64 cobblestone + 1 iron pickaxe. All setblock commands placed after fill commands to ensure correct override ordering.
